question: How do the eight original D6/D30 ATAC libraries differ in within-library signal ordering near annotation-based protein-coding TSS proxies, and how sensitive are those differences to window width?
decision: Describe the finite-source relative-ordering endpoint, retaining all windows and examples; narrow interpretation if displacements are small, mixed across libraries or width-sensitive. Return completed evidence for coordinator review before S5/S6. This does not reproduce original retained memory domains.
strongest_rival: Unknown nonlinear preprocessing and bulk cell-mixture/preparation differences can alter relative ordering without within-cell regulatory persistence. Rank dependence on the fixed universe, unresolved pool membership and unmatched assays limit biological interpretation.
discriminator: Compare all two-control/two-history libraries within D6 and D30 over annotation-fixed chr1-19/X protein-coding 5-prime-boundary windows, using exact means and tie-aware ranks at plus/minus 1 kb and 2 kb. Preserve four unpaired contrasts, spread and all fixed examples; no method here resolves original domain identity or deposited units.
exposure_record: Published findings, S1M/S2/S4/S4B and S3Q headers/bounded readability counts were viewed before this specification. Coordinator reviewed the explicit adapted endpoint. Annotation-only preview identified 21775 eligible genes/21760 windows per width. Six S4 examples are outcome-exposed; Aim2 is a published anchor. Artificial and upstream toy fixtures tested implementation only; no adapted research-track means or ranks were calculated before freeze. A freeze does not erase exposure.
biological_unit: Eight original deposited ATAC libraries, two per history/time group. Source-reported biological replication and pooled preparations remain positive evidence; exact animals, overlap and cross-assay matches remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: This reuses the original GSE92967 source, not independent replication. Genes, overlapping windows and the four cross-library contrasts are dependent features/diagnostics, not independent biological replicates. R1/R2 labels imply no pairing.
population_and_selection: All M9 gene features with gene_type protein_coding on chr1-19/X; their strand-specific 5-prime boundaries define proxies, not dominant or only transcript promoters. Collapse identical coordinates and retain all mappings, overlaps and clipped flags. Expected 21775 genes/21760 windows per width. No expression/peak/outcome filter; distal regions, noncoding genes, Y/M and noncanonical contigs are outside this endpoint.
contrast: Within each library/width, P=100*(ascending average one-based rank of the exact exported mean-1)/(N-1). Delta_t=mean history P-mean control P, in percentile points. Retain all four H_i-C_j values at each time and their range; compare D6/D30 continuous displacements and plus/minus 1 versus 2 kb.
endpoint: Finite-library relative ordering of exact deposited signal means in annotation-based TSS-proxy windows; signed/absolute displacement distributions and width sensitivity. This is not absolute accessibility, global opening, gene expression, original memory-domain classification or causal retention.
methods: Pinned WSL Python 3.13.18/pybbi 0.4.2/NumPy 2.5.5 reads every window at base resolution with missing=NaN and exact=True, preserving encoded zeros. Host code retains exact exported means with float round-trip parsing, average ties and fixed mean rank 50 percentile points. Summaries use quantiles 0,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,1; all four-contrast ranges, zero inclusion, absolute D30<D6 fraction, D6/D30 direction disagreement and continuous width shifts/sign sensitivity. Computational zero only 1e-10 pp. Fixed seven examples are Aim2 plus the six prior S4 examples; preserve unassayed status and no substitutions. Two PNG/PDF figures are fixed in S3_METHOD_V1. Independent stdlib verification reparses all coordinates/mappings/ranks/contrasts/summaries/selection. Separately reread 32 evenly spaced annotation-order windows per width plus every eligible example in all eight libraries through exact interval integration and math.fsum.
missingness_and_exclusions: Fail on unexpected missing/nonfinite base values or incomplete intervals; preserve partial output and do not impute/drop windows. Encoded zeros remain zeros. Noncoding examples such as Xist are unassayed NA, not zero accessibility. Preserve all prespecified eligible windows/libraries; no selection based on observed signs.
multiplicity: No p-values, population confidence intervals, biological classes, equivalence margins or new winner selection. Window fractions are finite feature descriptions; all-combination ranges are spread diagnostics.
precision_basis: Two deposited libraries per group do not establish population precision or a biological equivalence margin. 1e-10 is computational tolerance only; 32 spaced rereads plus fixed examples is a predetermined arithmetic check, not power or biological validation.
interpretation_limit: Every library mean rank is constrained to 50 pp and global mean contrast to zero; higher rank need not mean increased local signal. Positive affine transformations of window means preserve ordering; unknown nonlinear base processing, clipping, smoothing and mixture effects can remain. Protein-coding boundary proxies omit noncoding/distal regulation and cannot recover original memory-domain counts. No intrinsic memory, causal retention or repair conclusion, and no same-cell/animal RNA-ATAC interpretation.
stop_rule: Require committed frozen contract/code and all input hashes. Fail on source/runtime/universe mismatch, unexpected missing/nonfinite values, failed independent verification, over 7200 analysis-entrypoint seconds, over 2048 MiB peak WSL reader RSS or over 50 MiB derived artifacts. Preserve partial/failed real runs and diagnose concrete bottlenecks; never label a runtime limit source unavailability. No original-plan boundary relaxation, restricted broad extraction, safeguards change or external publication.
amendment_reason: Initial biological S3 contract for the separately reviewed rank adaptation in S3_AMENDMENT_V1.md; explicit prospective amendment to the historical plan, not a replacement of S3Q metadata or satisfaction of the original retained-region/magnitude-comparability condition.
